prompt: transform this video into a photorealistic 3D scene
framework: Builds [gate], Playback [gate], Prompt adherence, Reference fidelity, Scene fidelity, Composition, Lighting, Materials, Motion, Realism, Camera path, Viewpoint consistency, Motion timing (Orbit gate dropped on request)

rubric.c: The HTML opens in Chrome and the scene renders, with no errors or blank screen
The scene runs at 30 fps or more on a standard laptop
The flyover starts playing on load; pause freezes the camera and everything in the scene; play resumes from the same frame
The result is a 3D scene drawn live in the browser (geometry seen through a moving camera), not a video file or a flat image sequence played back
Nothing is added that the video does not contain: no text, logos or overlays on the scene, no extra objects (birds, clouds, people, vehicles), and no interaction beyond the playback controls
Dense green broadleaf forest covers the near hills and fills the lower half of the opening view, as in the video
Layered mountain ridges span the full width of the background, with the same skyline profile as the video (highest ridge left of centre, lower ridges stepping down to the right)
A brown tilled field lies in a clearing among the trees and comes to dominate the lower-middle of the view in the second half of the clip
A greenhouse complex with rows of white or silver tunnel roofs and one long red-roofed building sits at the lower right by the end of the clip
A pale dirt track and a small dark pond are visible among the trees at the lower right in the first half of the clip
The valley on the right holds terraced, striped crop plots and scattered small farm buildings, including green-roofed ones
The sky is clear and cloudless: a bright, almost white haze at the upper left grading to teal blue at the right
Colours and time of day match the video: strong daytime sun, warm saturated greens in the foreground, cooler blue-green in the distance
Without the prompt, the scene is recognisable as an aerial view over forested hills with farmland in a valley
The hills have real relief: rounded slopes, folds and valleys with depth, not a flat backdrop or a single plane
The forest canopy reads as individual tree crowns of varied size and height, not a smooth carpet or uniform blobs
Buildings and greenhouses keep their shape: straight edges, evenly spaced parallel roof rows, no bent, broken or merged lines
The opening view matches the video's first frame: horizon about a third of the way down, sky above, ridges across the middle, forest below
The horizon stays level for the whole clip
Light comes from the upper left as in the video: the sky is brightest there and tree crowns are lit on that side with shade on the other
Distant ridges are paler and bluer than the near hills (atmospheric haze)
Exposure looks natural: forest shadows are dark but keep detail, and no large area is crushed to black or blown out to flat white beyond what the video shows
Trees cast shadows where the video shows them, for example along the near edge of the tilled field
Foliage reads as leaves: matte, mottled light and dark greens, not flat colour or plastic
The tilled field reads as bare furrowed soil, with fine plough lines visible
Greenhouse roofs read as bright sheeting or plastic film, clearly brighter than their surroundings, and the red roof reads as a matte painted roof
Nothing in the scene moves by itself that does not in the video: no invented swaying trees, drifting clouds or animated water
When the clip ends it restarts cleanly from the first frame, with a single cut and no blank, black or half-drawn frame
No repeating texture tiles and no identical cloned trees are visible in the forest or fields
No clipping, floating pieces, stretched or smeared surfaces, including where tree outlines cross fields, roads and roofs
A paused frame could pass for a frame of the video at first glance
The camera flies straight forward over the forest toward the valley at a steady height, without turning, tilting or rolling
The move takes about 19 seconds at an even speed, with no sudden speed changes, stutter or shake that the video does not have
The final view matches the video's last frame: greenhouse complex at the lower right, a corner of the tilled field at the bottom left, ridges unchanged across the background
Ground revealed as the camera advances (the field behind the trees, the greenhouses behind the tree line) appears complete, with no holes, blank areas or stretched fill
Nothing pops: objects do not jump, flicker, change shape or pulse in sharpness from frame to frame
The frame is complete to its edges for the whole clip: no unfinished borders, gaps or smeared edge pixels
Depth behaves as in the video: near treetops sweep past quickly, middle hills move slowly and the far ridges barely move

Key reveals happen at the same moments as in the video: pond and track at the lower right by about 5 s, the tilled field opening up by about 10 s, the red-roofed building emerging from behind the trees at about 14 s, the whole greenhouse complex in view at the end
Paused at any moment, the page shows the same view as the video at that time, with objects in the same places in the frame
